crossRefs.note: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in…
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else…
Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

translations.web: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
translations.bsb: Who can strip off his outer coat? Who can approach him with a bridle?
translations.kjv: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
translations.asv: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who shall come within his jaws?
